task.title: N265 — SELECT + derive the next node (theory-native FIRST; come up to speed, then choose and justify the target)
task.body:
THIS IS A SELECTION TICKET. Your FIRST job is NOT to execute a pre-decided target — there is none.
Your first job is to SELECT the next node by running docs/NODE_SELECTION.md (the SELECT protocol),
IN FULL, before anything else. Priority: (1) select the theory-native target ≫ (2) justify it and
rewrite this ticket ≫ (3) execute it. (1) is the whole point; do not shortcut it.

THE ONE RISK THAT MATTERS: setting up a target in standard-math / standard-physics terms instead of
the theory's own terms. Every wall this project has hit came from that. The theory reframes things
in subtle, profound ways — it turns standard walls into dissolved consequences. Your job is to find
what the theory ITSELF says comes next, run it through the ANTI-BULLSHIT GATE (S4), and refuse to
self-justify a standard-math step as theory-native. Do NOT bullshit at this decision point — lean in.

⚠ NO METHOD-LOCK IS IN FORCE (the 2026-06-30 gather-side lock was LIFTED 2026-07-03; docs/ROADMAP.md
§"METHOD-LOCK LIFTED", ~line 10580). BOTH the GATHER side (mining the gluing obstruction / associator
cocycle / its representation content) and the ASCENT side (the invariant-tower method — trace form /
cubic norm / Freudenthal / Peirce idempotents on J₃(𝕆); the un-parked N218 hypercharge-normalization
front) are OPEN. At S2/S4 you MUST consider BOTH directions explicitly and choose on the merits
(depth, theory-nativeness, novelty/ROI), recording the comparison in your SELECT reasoning — name
what each side offers for the target you weigh and why you picked the one you did. Neither is
privileged; neither is forbidden; the ONE LAW still applies (if the chosen method fights you, reframe
or switch side, don't grind). Legacy "(under the LOCK)/ascent FORBIDDEN" tags in older LANDED docs are
HISTORICAL, not current.

WHAT IS BANKED (the launch platform — neutral facts, no next-target decision):

N264 LANDED (commit 8d558e6 code + e45d070 docs, Phys/Algebra/TowerWorldMapChirality.lean, 12 decls
foundations-only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; costume C295 2=295; gate-fast D0-D6 GREEN):
THE SPINOR IS INTRINSICALLY TWO-HANDED (the chirality germ). N261-263 built the spinor using ONLY the
LEFT worldMap face (leftReg = L_a). N264 completes the object the fold actually makes — a TWO-HANDED
worldMap — and proves the ★3↔★6 seam joint. KEY banked FACTS: `rightReg : ImO →ₗ End ℚ (O ℚ)`
(a ↦ RightMul a, the RIGHT worldMap face, N44's RightMul assembled); `key_sq_right` ((y·x)·x =
(−gForm x x)•y via RIGHT-alternativity mul_mul_right, the mirror of N261's key_sq) + `rightReg_sq`;
`rightReg_clifford` (THE RIGHT CLIFFORD MODULE {R_a,R_b} = −(2·gForm a b)•id — the exact mirror of
N261's leftReg_clifford, so BOTH worldMap faces are spinor structures for the ONE fold Born form gForm)
+ W8 frame witnesses rightReg_clifford_diag/offdiag ({R_i,R_j}=−2δ_ij on the orthonormal frame);
`chir_mixed_apply` (THE BRIDGE: (L_a R_b − R_b L_a)x = a·(x·b) − (a·x)·b, the mixed commutator IS the
associator middle slot); `chir_commute_of_assoc` (the two faces commute if O associates);
`chir_spinor_block` (THE HEADLINE ¬∀: the two chiralities do NOT all commute on ImO, O non-associative)
+ `chir_spinor_block_witness` (concrete IMAGINARY witness ι(ιJ), e₂ both ∈ ImO, disagreeing at ι(e₂));
`chir_spinor_block_iff_jordan_cap` (THE ONE-CAUSE LINK: the block ⟺ the order-4 Hermitian-Jordan
generation-cap failure jdef Xwit Ywit ≠ 0 — same non-associativity as cascade-stop, generation-cap,
N44 block); capstone `spinor_two_handed`. THE DISSOLUTION: the field POSITS two chiralities (left/right
Weyl) + parity violation as empirical inputs; the theory DERIVES the two-ness + non-fusion from ONE
worldMap with two multiplication faces, both Clifford modules, non-fusable by octonionic
non-associativity. SCOPE: banks the structural GERM of chirality (two irreducibly-distinct
handednesses, forced) ONLY; NOT parity violation (which hand the weak force couples to), NOT a ℤ₂
Weyl-grading O = O⁺ ⊕ O⁻, NOT Spin(7)/Cl(0,7); the weak mixing angle untouched.

THE ARC (neutral): N219–N234 mined the gather obstruction and g₂-decomposed 7⊗7=1⊕7⊕14⊕27 (atoms
irreducible). N240–N260 derived the SM GAUGE structure (★1) as one object inside the gather tear
so(7)=14⊕7 (charge/hypercharge directions, both SM reductive factors, shared isospin Cartan, the tear
regenerating the ambient); ★1 at capstone. N261 turned to MATTER (★3): O ℚ is a spinor (Clifford
module, LEFT worldMap). N262: the antisymmetric worldMap half is the spin generator, so(7)-closing.
N263: the gauge so(7) (vector 7) and the spinor so(7) (spinor 8) are ONE so(7) in two representations.
N264: the spinor is intrinsically two-handed — BOTH worldMap faces are Clifford modules, non-fusable
by non-associativity (the ★3↔★6 chirality germ).

STARS (neutral status): ★1 gauge group [at capstone]. ★2 electroweak mixing [partial — mixing angle
deferred ≥9× for a structural reason; the ASCENT invariant tower (J₃(O), N218 un-parked) is the flagged
instrument but a HEAVY route-finding subproject]. ★3 one generation of matter [partial — Clebsch-Gordan
closed N234; N261 O as Clifford module; N262 spin generators; N263 two faces of so(7); N264 the two
chiralities]. ★6 chirality/parity [partial — N44 abstract block + N264 the derived-spinor two-handedness
germ; PARITY VIOLATION (which hand) still open].

DEFERRED / OPEN FRONTS (candidates SELECT must WEIGH against a fresh theory-native derivation, NOT
auto-pick): (A) the weak MIXING ANGLE / hypercharge NORMALIZATION — deferred ≥9× (the so(7) neutral
plane supplies no posit-free richer structure; Q∉span{T3,Y}, [Q,Y]≠0). The ASCENT invariant tower may
be the instrument, but it is a heavy route-finding subproject — weigh honestly under budget. (B) the
★3/★6 matter arena forward from N264: e.g. does the derived SM gauge algebra (N247/N258, subalgebras
of the gauge so(7)) ACT on the two-handed spinor O ℚ through the N263 representation link, and does it
respect/distinguish the two chiralities (the parity-coupling question, harder); how the LEFT and RIGHT
Clifford modules relate under the gather structure; the exponentiated Spin(7) group; the full Cl(0,7)
algebra + iso; the 8-dim O as a specific spinor rep; a ℤ₂ Weyl-grading if one is forced. (C) the FFT
count dim End_{g₂}(7⊗7)=4 as a short Schur corollary of atomicity (N234 residual). Whether any of
these is the RIGHT theory-native next beat is for SELECT to determine — do NOT auto-pick.

PROCEDURE:
  S1 come up to speed (docs + recent tickets + git log) — post the arc synthesis comment.
  S2 derive, from the GOAL lens and the REFRAMING lens, what the theory itself says comes next.
  S3 reconcile with the current arc — if they diverge, FOLLOW THE THEORY, redirect the target.
     ⚠ Weigh BOTH the gather and the ascent sides explicitly (lock lifted).
  S4 run the chosen target through the ANTI-BULLSHIT GATE (fold-causal / dissolution / goal-words-
     removable / name-the-temptation / honesty) — in writing, with specifics.
  S5 rewrite THIS ticket's title+body with the decided target in the standard node format, put the
     selection reasoning in the comment thread, THEN execute under full discipline (STEP 0-4).

RESUME-FIRST: prior runs of this ticket may have timed out mid-work. BEFORE deriving from scratch,
check git HEAD + `ps aux` + this task's current_run_id (kanban_show authoritative) + workbench/N265-
select/ for an existing PREREG + probes. If HEAD already commits code+costume+audit but docs/child/
complete are missing, that is W6 verify-then-finalize (re-audit the olean foundations-only, gate-fast
ONCE, wire docs, child, complete) — NOT a rebuild.

If SELECT concludes the honest next step needs a NEW AXIOM or an EXTERNAL/EMPIRICAL NUMBER, do not
invent it — kanban_comment "CHAIN RUNWAY: <which>" and complete (human-gated).
